grader_summary: Scenario assertions 5/7, universal 7/7. Both failures stem from the same cause: the detail reviewer returned three Mediums on the control fixture and the orchestrator carried them verbatim, yielding 'not yet — 3 blocking' instead of 'acceptable'. Finding 1 (undefined `risky` verdict value, E1) is a genuine, verifiable gap, though its D1 co-key contradicts the report's own D1 credit. Findings 2 (A26/F4) and 3 (A7) are inflated: each scores the fixture as deficient on a criterion the report's 'What's already right' section says it satisfies — A26's stated remedy (tool restriction plus content-is-data rule) is fully present, and A7's rule (bound the verbosity) is met by the 400-word cap — and Finding 3 reads a 'complete edit list' requirement into text that never states one. No quote is fabricated; all 19 checked quotes are verbatim. None of the three blocking findings rests on a criterion this branch changed (git diff main shows A7, A26, E1, D1, F4 untouched). Compared with the previous campaign: A3/A5 crediting is fixed (was a FAIL), the C1 cap-conflict finding persists re-keyed as A7, the A26 concern was promoted from Low to Medium, and the `risky` finding is new. Report structure, locators, Manifests lines, inferential marking and report-only discipline all pass.
